headline: JBS Faces Money Laundering Complaints Over Amazon Deforestation
summary: Campaigners have filed 14 complaints across four European countries accusing Brazilian beef giant JBS of laundering money linked to Amazon deforestation. The company has rejected the allegations.
why: JBS is one of the world's largest meat processors; ESG-related legal risks can impact institutional investment and market access.

impacts.name: JBS
impacts.why: Legal and ESG controversies can lead to divestment and reputational damage.
